items.question: What exactly is AI by dentsu - and how is it different from tools like ChatGPT or other AI platforms?
items.answer: AI by dentsu is a suite of seven proprietary AI products built specifically for marketing - from tracking how AI chatbots talk about your brand, to analysing consumer opinion at scale, to accelerating creative production. Unlike general-purpose AI tools, our products are built from scratch by marketing practitioners, trained on real campaign data, and delivered as a managed service - with our experts embedded in every step. You don't log in and figure it out alone. We configure, run, and interpret the results with you.

items.question: Do I need to be an existing dentsu client to use these products?
items.answer: No. Our AI products are available to any brand - whether you already work with dentsu or not. The best starting point is a 30-minute demo, where we show the product running on your category and your competitors. No commitment required.

items.question: Is this a SaaS subscription or something else?
items.answer: It's a managed service, not a self-serve platform. We don't sell logins. Our specialists configure the product to your brand, run the analysis, interpret the findings, and - where relevant - feed them directly to the dentsu media, creative, or CXM (Customer Experience Management) teams working on your campaigns. You get conclusions ready to act on, not a dashboard to manage.

items.question: How is my data protected, and will it be used to train AI models?
items.answer: Your data never leaves your isolated environment. Your briefs, prompts, content, and analysis results are never used to train public AI models. Every engagement runs in a dedicated instance with access limited to named users only. Our setup is built to clear legal and security reviews.

items.question: How quickly can we get started and what does the process look like?
items.answer: A first demo takes 30 minutes and requires nothing from your side upfront. From there, we align on your business objective and scope. We'll give you a realistic timeline at the demo stage, not after a contract is signed.
